about_the_game:
Apocalypse Factory is an automation game with tower defense mechanics, using mining, crafting, and creating production lines to fulfill your production orders for people who live in the underground bunker and clear the world from zombies.

You have been sent to the surface to produce items and resources and then deliver them to all the people in bunkers.

The task is not easy, you have to defend your production lines against zombies and gangs.

You have to create electrical power networks to power machines and other equipment and generate electricity using wind power, and other resources.

current features

  • Create complex production lines and watch them run.

  • A huge map.

  • a lot of different resources to mine.

  • a lot of items to craft.

  • a lot of machines, and structures to build.

  • different weapons and guns to defend your production lines.

  • a lot of technologies to research.

Playtesting will be available soon, Join the Discord Server if you are interested in playtesting to provide suggestions and feedback.
